title: EgoHand Twin — per-frame record (landmarks.jsonl line), v1
description: One JSON object per processed video frame, including frames with no hands. Extends the EgoHand Twin milestone JSONL with camera-space 3D, wrist pose, grip aperture, quality masks and provenance. Field names follow the milestone where they already exist. Aligned with Project Aria MPS hand tracking (camera/device-frame metres, per-hand confidence, wrist pose, palm normal), Apple EgoDex (per-joint pose + confidence, NaN/0 for occluded) and LeRobot (timestamp / frame_index). Coordinates: image_* are normalised to the source frame; world_* are MediaPipe hand-relative metres; cam_* are camera-frame metres (x right, y down, z forward) estimated with the lens model in manifest.json. Landmark order is MediaPipe's 21-point order unless stated otherwise.

frame_index.description: Index of the decoded source frame.

timestamp_s.description: Seconds since the first source presentation timestamp (PTS).

source_pts_s.description: Original source presentation timestamp in seconds.

quality.description: Frame-level measured signals and HOT3D-style boolean masks.

hand_observed.description: At least one hand has state observed/reacquired.

cam_space_valid.description: At least one hand has cam_xyz_m with reprojection error under the manifest threshold.

track_id.description: Short-term association ID; may change after a hand leaves view.

state.description: Milestone state machine. Only observed/reacquired carry 3D.

anatomical_side.description: Offline anatomical identity (not the per-frame classifier).

handedness_score.description: MediaPipe left/right classifier score. NOT a detection or landmark confidence.

detection_origin.description: Which detection path produced this hand.

confidence.description: Hand-level tracking confidence (Aria-style). Null if no calibrated confidence exists; never copied from handedness_score.

image_xyz_raw.description: Normalised x,y; z = wrist-relative model depth (not metric). Raw model output.

image_xyz.description: Filtered image coordinates (or raw with smoothing off). Predicted state may carry 2D only.

world_xyz_m_raw.description: MediaPipe hand-relative metres, origin near the hand centre. Raw.

cam_xyz_m.description: NEW: camera-frame metres from lens model + PnP root depth, after bone-length calibration. Null when not observed or invalid.

cam_xyz_m_raw.description: NEW: camera-frame metres before bone-length calibration and smoothing.

wrist_pose_cam.description: NEW: 6-DoF wrist pose in camera frame (Aria-style t + q). Orientation from the palm plane (wrist, index MCP, pinky MCP).

palm_normal_cam.description: NEW: unit normal out of the palm, camera frame.

grip_aperture_m.description: NEW: 3D distance thumb tip (4) to index tip (8).

bone_length_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of bone lengths for this track up to this frame.

depth_plausible.description: Wrist depth within the manifest's plausible range (e.g. 0.2-0.9 m).

mesh_ref.description: Optional key of a MANO/WiLoR mesh stored separately (frame_index, track_id).

provenance.description: Which fields are measured, predicted by a model, or inferred by rules.
